description: This file defines a 'CartPage' component for a furniture shopping app's frontend, using a component-based architecture with LightningJS. It manages layout, state, and subscriptions for displaying cart contents and checkout modal.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initial state of the component, including layout parameters and modal visibility.

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Defines reactive watchers for width and height to adjust layout dynamically.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Sets up subscription to the application store to toggle checkout modal visibility.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, invoking watchers for current dimensions.
